prompt: GEPT 口說題：被問到「你喜歡在家讀書嗎？」哪個回答文法正確又完整？
options: Yes, I do, because it is quiet and I can set my own pace.
Yes, I like, because quiet and I can set own pace.
Yes, I do, because it quiet and I set pace my own.
Yes, I am, because it is quiet and I can set my pace own.
answer: Yes, I do, because it is quiet and I can set my own pace.

wrong.Yes, I like, because quiet and I can set: like 後面少了受詞，because 後面缺 it is，own 前也缺 my。
wrong.Yes, I do, because it quiet and I set pa: it 後面缺 be 動詞 is，而且 my own pace 的順序被顛倒。
wrong.Yes, I am, because it is quiet and I can: 問句是 Do you like，要用 do 回答，不能用 am；own 也放錯位置。

why: Do you like 開頭的問題用 Yes, I do 回答；because 後接完整子句，my own pace 的順序也正確。
tip: Do you 開頭的問句，就用 do 或 don't 回答。
say: Yes, I do, because it is quiet and I can set my own pace.

text: The company's plan was a clear _____ for the next five years: it listed every goal and step.
options: blueprint
blue jeans
blueberry
bluebird

wrong.blue jeans: blue jeans 是「藍色牛仔褲」，不能用來描述詳細計畫。
wrong.blueberry: blueberry 是藍莓，與計畫無關。
wrong.bluebird: bluebird 是藍鳥，和列出目標與步驟的意思不合。

why: blueprint 原指藍圖，也可比喻為詳細的計畫，與句中列出每個目標和步驟相符。
tip: blueprint 除了藍圖，也能指詳細的計畫。
say: The plan was a clear blueprint for the next five years.

prompt: 朋友問你為什麼選擇獨自準備中高級口說，你想表達「因為我可以專心」，哪句最自然？
options: I prefer it because I can focus better on my own.
I prefer it because I am focus better by myself.
I prefer that I can focus because own better.
I prefer it, but I focus because I am alone better.
answer: I prefer it because I can focus better on my own.

wrong.I prefer it because I am focus better by: am 與 focus 不能同時當動詞，應直接用 can focus。
wrong.I prefer that I can focus because own be: because own better 不是完整子句，語意也不連貫。
wrong.I prefer it, but I focus because I am al: but 讓句子變成轉折，與「所以喜歡」的因果不合，better 也放錯位置。

why: I prefer it because... 先說偏好再說原因；can focus better on my own 說明獨自學習的好處。
tip: 說原因時，because 後面要接完整句子。
say: I prefer it because I can focus better on my own.

prompt: 這句話的 proficient 是什麼意思？
text: After years of practice, she became proficient in written English.
options: 熟練、精通
容易生氣
非常害羞
常常遲到

wrong.容易生氣: 句子談的是練習多年後的成果，不是情緒。
wrong.非常害羞: proficient 描述能力，不是個性害羞。
wrong.常常遲到: 句中沒有時間或遲到的線索，proficient 也不表示遲到。

why: After years of practice 暗示她已經很熟練，所以 proficient in 是「精通……」。
tip: proficient in 後面接領域，表示精通。
say: She became proficient in written English.

prompt: 哪一句把 spontaneous 用得正確？
options: Her speech was spontaneous, not memorized.
Her speech was spontaneously, not memorized.
Her speech spontaneous was not memorize.
Her speech is spontaneity, not memorized.
answer: Her speech was spontaneous, not memorized.

wrong.Her speech was spontaneously, not memori: was 後面要接形容詞，spontaneously 是副詞，不能這樣用。
形容詞放在 was 前面語序錯誤，memorize 也要寫成 memorized。
wrong.Her speech is spontaneity, not memorized: spontaneity 是名詞，和後面的 memorized 無法形成對比。

why: was 後面接形容詞 spontaneous，與 not memorized 形成對比，意思是「即興的、不是背稿的」。
tip: be 動詞後面要接形容詞，不是副詞。
say: Her speech was spontaneous, not memorized.

prompt: 在 GEPT 寫作中，你想用一句話開頭表達「現今許多學生比以前更常使用線上課程」，哪個最自然？
options: Nowadays, more and more students take online courses.
Nowadays, more and more student takes online courses.
Nowadays, many more students is taking online course.
Nowadays, students more and more take online courses.
answer: Nowadays, more and more students take online courses.

wrong.Nowadays, more and more student takes on: more and more 後面要接複數名詞 students，動詞也要用 take。
wrong.Nowadays, many more students is taking o: students 是複數，不能搭配 is，course 也要用複數。
wrong.Nowadays, students more and more take on: more and more 放在主詞後面不自然，要放在 students 前面。

why: more and more + 複數名詞 + 原形動詞，是描述趨勢的標準句型。
tip: more and more 後面接複數名詞，動詞用複數形。
say: Nowadays, more and more students take online courses.

prompt: 選出最適合的連接詞片語。
text: I usually study alone _____ I can work at my own pace.
options: because
although
unless
even though

wrong.although: although 表示讓步（雖然），但句子是在給原因。
wrong.unless: unless 是「除非」，會變成「除非我能照自己步調才獨自讀書」，語意不合。
wrong.even though: even though 表示「即使」，會變成雖然能照自己步調卻獨自讀書，邏輯反了。

why: 空格後面說明獨自讀書的原因，所以用 because。
tip: 給原因用 because，讓步用 although。
say: I usually study alone because I can work at my own pace.

text: The article claims that the new sample does not support the earlier explanation.
options: 新資料與先前說法不吻合
新資料證明先前說法完全正確
作者沒有提到任何資料
先前的說法被刪除了
answer: 新資料與先前說法不吻合

wrong.新資料證明先前說法完全正確: does not support 是否定，表示不支持，不是證明正確。
wrong.作者沒有提到任何資料: 句中明確提到 the new sample，也就是有新資料。
wrong.先前的說法被刪除了: 句子沒說被刪除，只說新樣本無法支持這個說法。

why: does not support 表示新樣本無法證實原本的解釋，所以兩者並不吻合。
tip: does not support = 無法證實，不等於刪除。
say: The new sample does not support the earlier explanation.

prompt: 你想禮貌地請教授看你的作文草稿，哪一句最得體？
options: Excuse me, Professor Lin. Would you have a few minutes to look at my draft?
Hey, Professor Lin. You look my draft now.
Professor Lin, give me your minutes for my draft.
Excuse me, Professor Lin. Do you look at draft?
answer: Excuse me, Professor Lin. Would you have a few minutes to look at my draft?

wrong.Hey, Professor Lin. You look my draft no: 對教授說 Hey 太隨便，而且用命令式語氣不禮貌，look 後也缺 at。
wrong.Professor Lin, give me your minutes for: 這是命令句，聽起來像要求對方交出時間，沒有請求的禮貌語氣。
wrong.Excuse me, Professor Lin. Do you look at: Do you look at 是問習慣，不是請求，draft 前也缺 my。

why: Would you have a few minutes to... 是請託長輩或老師常用的客氣說法，語氣有禮又清楚。
tip: 請教師長幫忙，用 Would you have a few minutes to 開頭。
say: Would you have a few minutes to look at my draft?

prompt: GEPT 寫作中，哪一句的主題句最完整？
options: Exercising regularly is important because it keeps us healthy.
Exercising regularly important because keeps us healthy.
To exercising regularly is important because healthy.
Exercise regularly is importance, because it keep healthy.
answer: Exercising regularly is important because it keeps us healthy.

wrong.Exercising regularly important because k: 句子缺少 be 動詞 is，because 後面也少了主詞 it。
wrong.To exercising regularly is important bec: to 後面應接原形動詞，不能接 exercising，because 後也缺主詞和動詞。
wrong.Exercise regularly is importance, becaus: importance 是名詞，要用 important；keep 要加 s，而且 healthy 前缺 us。

why: 動名詞 Exercising 當主詞，is important 是主要述語，because it keeps us healthy 補充原因。
tip: 動名詞當主詞，後面接單數動詞 is。
say: Exercising regularly is important because it keeps us healthy.

prompt: 說話者的真正意思是什麼？
text: Your introduction caught my attention, but what is your main claim?
options: 開頭很吸引人，但還不清楚主要論點
文章太長，請刪掉開頭
我沒有看，所以不知道
你的主張很清楚，不需要改
answer: 開頭很吸引人，但還不清楚主要論點

wrong.文章太長，請刪掉開頭: 句中是稱讚開頭吸引人，沒有要求刪掉。
wrong.我沒有看，所以不知道: caught my attention 表示已經看過並被吸引。
wrong.你的主張很清楚，不需要改: but what is your main claim 表示主張還不清楚。

why: 前半句稱讚開頭，but 之後轉為提問，暗示主要論點還需要說明或寫得更清楚。
tip: but 之後的內容常是說話者真正想問的重點。
say: Your introduction caught my attention, but what is your main claim?

prompt: 和朋友聊讀書方法，你想說「向別人解釋概念，會讓我發現自己沒搞懂的部分」，哪句最合適？
options: Explaining ideas to others shows me what I don't understand yet.
Explain ideas to others show me what I don't understood.
Explaining ideas others shows me what don't I understand.
Explaining ideas to others is show me I understand not.
answer: Explaining ideas to others shows me what I don't understand yet.

wrong.Explain ideas to others show me what I d: 主詞 Explain 要用動名詞 Explaining，show 要加 s，don't 後面不能接過去式。
wrong.Explaining ideas others shows me what do: ideas 後缺 to，what 子句語序要正常，應是 what I don't understand。
wrong.Explaining ideas to others is show me I: is 與 show 重複當動詞，not 的位置也不符合英語否定規則。

why: 動名詞片語當主詞，動詞用 shows；what I don't understand 是名詞子句，語序維持主詞加動詞。
tip: 名詞子句中的語序是 what + 主詞 + 動詞。
say: Explaining ideas to others shows me what I don't understand yet.
